csv_export.note: Not used by the build. Byte-identical to the CSV vita-vn-ocr's vocab-expand study fetched at 2026-10-14T06:32:41Z, so that study and this build use the same list revision. The Yomitan dictionary is used instead: it pairs each kanji form with every observed reading and carries the kana-form ranks, which the CSV (main reading only) does not.

kanji.note: The release asset unchanged (GitHub's asset digest is the same sha256). 12,634 term rows: 3,904 Jiten and 8,729 KANJIDIC2-fallback cards (its MANIFEST.json, records.total 12,633) and 髙, a variant row without a card. The build reads only each card's English meaning line; the stroke-order SVGs and pie charts in the ZIP are not used.
